title: trigonotis radicans var. sericea
intro: Trigonotis radicans var. sericea, commonly known as silky trigonotis, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, that may help alleviate various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of silky trigonotis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit hepatoprotective effects, and exhibit anti-diabetic activities. The bioactive constituents of silky trigonotis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
